component.name: RecoverySuite
component.summary: Find lost files and recover them to another drive

description.p: Search supported FAT, exFAT, NTFS and ext4 records on connected disks or disk images, inspect candidates and recover selected files to another drive.
This development prototype uses read-only source access, verifies exported bytes and reports unsupported or partial results. Overwritten or unreadable bytes cannot be recreated.

Device and host-file access are required for source selection and recovery destinations. Privileged source reads require host UDisks2 authorization. Physical failing-drive qualification remains pending.
